ReasonforDeviation_Q1:
The Deviation by 25 children is due to the following:
•	Biological fathers whose whereabouts were reported to be unknown in Alfred Nzo in respect of 4 foster children showed up and claimed responsibility and rights over their children. A father of 1 child was also found in Amathole and they were re-united.
•	A relative for 4 foster children in the O. R. Tambo District claimed responsibility and rights over the children whom are her siblings. 
•	Re-unification processes in respect of 6 foster children that were not finalized in the last financial year due to the nature of the process/service which is dependent on the readiness of the children and their families, were completed in this quarter under review in the Joe Gqabi District. 
•	Re-unification processes in respect of 3 foster children in the Sarah Baartman District and 6 in the Nelson Mandela Metro were finalized earlier than anticipated or planned. Both the children and their biological parents were ready for re-unification and this condition was in the best interests of the children.
After all processes were followed, the children were re-unified towards stability in their lives as well as development to the best of their ability with support of their families of origin.
CorrectiveAction_Q1: Re-unification of foster children with their biological parents and/or legal guardians will always be done whenever the opportunity presents itself in the best interests of re-unifiable children. However, the Department will always follow re-unification processes.
ReasonforDeviation_Q2: The variance is due to Families in respect of 6 children from Sarah Baartman District that were ready for re-unification earlier than anticipated. Re-unification was, therefore, done in the best interests of the children forming the deviation in this report.
ReasonforDeviation_Q3:
The variance is due to more children re-unified in the previous two quarters earlier than anticipated. Twenty five children were already re-unified in the first (19) and second (6) quarters of this financial year making an over-performance against the target of 15 (first quarter -5 and second quarter -10).
The above confirms the fact that re-unification of children with their biological parents and/or legal guardians is a process that is always dependent on the readiness of both foster children and their families. It is always done in the best interests of the children. 
The processes are taking into consideration the circumstances surrounding each case and individuals involved.
CorrectiveAction_Q3: Re-unification of foster children with their biological parents and/or legal guardians will always be done whenever the opportunity presents itself in the best interests of all re-unifiable children. The Department will always follow re-unification processes.
ReasonforDeviation_Q4:
The variance is due to the following:
Re-unification of children with their biological parents and/or legal guardians is a process that is always dependent on the readiness of both foster children and their families. It is always done in the best interests of the children. 
The processes are taking into consideration the circumstances surrounding each case and individuals involved. An example of this is that 26 children were already re-unified in the first (20) and second (6) quarters of this financial year making an over-performance against the target of 5 first quarter and 10 second quarter.
This confirms the above statement on the consideration of the state of readiness of all the affected parties in the process.
CorrectiveAction_Q4: Re-unification of foster children with their biological parents or legal guardians will always be done whenever the opportunity presents itself in the best interests of all re-unifiable children. However, the Department will always follow re-unification processes.
